summary: Critical IPv6 SSRF gap (SA-2) is resolved with comprehensive IPv6 blocking. DNS rebinding limitation (SA-1) is documented. All required fixes applied.

findings.finding: IPv6 private ranges now blocked: ::1 (loopback), fc/fd prefix (ULA fc00::/7), fe8x-febx (link-local fe80::/10). Broad non-public-unicast block added (requires 2xxx/3xxx prefix). RESOLVED.
DNS rebinding limitation documented in validateSsrf() comment. Production egress firewall recommendation included. RESOLVED.
Double allowlist check rationale (path-oracle defense vs. symlink safety) now documented with clear comments. RESOLVED.

notes: SA-4 (User-Agent) remains as low priority — acceptable for single-user deployment.
